status: Targeted read-only primary-source audit; no production changes
scope: Selected 2026 membership transitions and two complete direct-FCS-opponent schedule spot checks

membershipChecks.name: North Dakota State
membershipChecks.verifiedFact: The official February 9, 2026 school announcement states that NDSU accepted a football affiliate invitation to the Mountain West and would compete at the Football Bowl Subdivision level beginning fall 2026.

membershipChecks.name: Sacramento State
membershipChecks.verifiedFact: The official February 16, 2026 announcement states that Sacramento State joins the MAC as a football-only member beginning July 1, 2026 and explicitly describes the FBS transition. The accompanying FAQ identifies the 2026 season as the first MAC schedule.

membershipChecks.name: Saint Francis
membershipChecks.identityNote: Saint Francis University in Pennsylvania; not St. Francis (IL), saved ID 2595
membershipChecks.verifiedFact: The official transition FAQ states that Saint Francis becomes a Division III reclassifying member beginning fall 2026. The NCAA directory's sponsored-sports row lists football as Division III in the Presidents' Athletic Conference for 2026-2027.

membershipChecks.name: West Florida
membershipChecks.verifiedFact: The official April 20, 2026 school announcement states that the university moves to NCAA Division I beginning fall 2026, with football playing as an FCS member of the United Athletic Conference. It identifies the August 27 opener against Southern Illinois as the first FCS game.

membershipChecks.name: West Georgia
membershipChecks.verifiedFact: The NCAA directory's football row lists FCS and United Athletic Conference for 2026-2027. The official 2026 schedule announcement describes the third year of Division I football; the official Kennesaw State game announcement explicitly calls West Georgia FCS for 2026.
membershipChecks.interpretationCaveat: The directory's general organization header still describes Division II reclassifying membership; use the sport-specific football designation for this audit.

caveats: Primary sources were fetched after the saved snapshot. Matching later-fetched results do not establish exactly what information was available on those websites at the historical snapshot cutoff.
All independently listed completed spot-check games occurred by October 31; the two official schedules list November 7 as the next game.

Snapshot final margins, opponent identities and model-inferred venue orientations can be checked. Dates and absolute final scores cannot be independently verified from contribution-only snapshot records.
This targeted audit does not independently certify all 138 FBS memberships, all FCS memberships or every game's metadata.
Institution-wide NCAA reclassification descriptions and postseason eligibility can differ from the sport-specific football classification; neither implies a ranking bonus or penalty.
No CFBD calls, account writes, source data corrections or production edits were made.
